notes: Contains multiple loose/floating parts likely corresponding to attached directional boards and mounting hardware.

blind.description: A stylized wooden signpost featuring a central square vertical timber post with a pyramidal cap. Several wooden arrow-shaped directional signboards are bolted onto the post at varying heights and angled in different directions. The surfaces are solid, smooth, and game-ready with hand-painted wood grain textures in warm brown tones and dark iron mounting studs. It stands directly on its base with no extra pedestal or ground slab.
blind.from_above: Shows the square pyramidal cap of the central post with three directional wooden planks extending outward like spokes pointing north, southwest, and south.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 to 5.0 feet tall, standing slightly lower than the top of the 5 ft 9 in figure, with a maximum width of roughly 2.5 feet across the directional boards.
